name: Logon or logon attempt by a disabled AD account
author: Sentra SOC
description: An account that Active Directory reports as disabled (userAccountControl ACCOUNTDISABLE, last AD sync) logged on, tried to log on or requested Kerberos tickets. Needs the AD identity sync (engine/ad): enrichment sets fields.user_disabled.

name: Successful logon by a dormant AD account
author: Sentra SOC
description: An account with no AD logon for more than ad.dormant_days (default 90; lastLogonTimestamp, or creation date when it never logged on) logged on successfully. Enrichment sets fields.user_dormant from the AD identity sync.

name: Member added to a privileged AD group
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 4728 / 4732 / 4756 where the target group is privileged: the built-in admin groups (Domain/Enterprise/Schema Admins, Administrators, Account/Backup/Server Operators, Group Policy Creator Owners, by name or well-known SID) or ad.privileged_groups. Enrichment sets fields.group_privileged.

name: New member of a privileged AD group since the last directory sync
author: Sentra SOC
description: The periodic AD identity sync found an account in a privileged group (nested membership resolved) that was not a member at the previous sync — catches changes made on a DC whose security log is not collected, or via nested groups.

name: Interactive logon by a service account
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 4624 logon type 2 (interactive), 10 (RDP) or 11 (cached) by an account matching ad.service_account_patterns (default svc-*, svc_*). Service accounts should only log on as services / batch / network.
